inputs.name: hand over from Acceptance Criteria to Model Evaluation Harness

output.level_0: Acceptance criteria contradict the evaluation harness, so no model ever passes the handover check.
output.level_1: There is no defined handover, so developers guess when a model is ready for the harness.
output.level_2: A project manager manually copies acceptance criteria into the evaluation harness configuration each week.
output.level_3: The system automatically validates acceptance criteria against the harness before triggering the evaluation run.
output.level_4: Governed handover ensures criteria and harness align, with audit logs for every model transition.
